specificationName: Correct MCP Tool Name and Parameters

changesApplied.changeMade: Fixed MCP tool name from 'post_activity_result' to 'metabob_post_activity_result', changed parameter name from 'activityId' to 'activity_id', and removed invalid 'backend' parameter
changesApplied.reason: Enforces correct MCP tool naming convention (all metabob-cli tools use 'metabob_' prefix) and matches MCP tool signature exactly (activity_id: str, result: dict). This fixes the critical bug where tool calls were failing with 'Tool not found' error.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low blast radius - isolated to single method in template-metrics-client.ts. No other components depend on this parameter structure. MCP tool registration (metabob-cli) and backend schema (metabob-rpc-api) already correct. Change enables full data flow: OpenCode → MCP → CLI → RPC API → Database.

enforcementImpulseId: enforcement-Correct MCP Tool Name and Parameters
